complete-stack.title: Complete Site Builder Stack
complete-stack.descriptionHtml:
What this is

The three Claude Code systems this site sells, bought together: the Website Launch System, the SEO & Website Audit Toolkit, and the Conversion & Revenue Optimization Toolkit. Nothing is abridged and nothing is exclusive to the bundle — these are the same three products, delivered as three downloads on one order.

267 files. Around 206,000 words of plain Markdown. No installer, no account, no subscription, no runtime.

The problem it addresses

Website projects tend to fail at one of three points, and the three failures need different work.

Some never launch properly. The build stalls, or it ships without the checks that would have caught the broken canonical, the missing alt text, the form that silently drops submissions. Some launch and are never found: technically sound, indexed slowly or not at all, ranking for nothing anyone searches. And some get traffic that does not turn into anything, where the honest answer to “why” requires evidence nobody has collected.

Buying one product solves one of those. Most sites eventually meet all three, in that order, and the systems are written to hand off to each other rather than to overlap.

How the three fit together

Stage Product The question it answers
Build Website Launch System How do I get a production-ready site out of Claude Code without shipping the usual mistakes?
Rank SEO & Website Audit Toolkit Why can nobody find this, and which of the twenty possible reasons is the real one?
Convert Conversion & Revenue Optimization Toolkit Where is the traffic being lost, what should I change first, and did the change actually work?

They share one discipline: audits change nothing, findings carry evidence rather than confidence, and every check is proved to fail before it is trusted to pass.

What is included

Product Contents
Website Launch System A production CLAUDE.md, a staged master build prompt, platform build systems for Shopify, WordPress, Astro, SaaS and landing pages, an SEO system, security and accessibility audits, 100 reusable prompts, and launch checklists
SEO & Website Audit Toolkit Twenty audit prompts in dependency order, from crawlability through canonicals, indexing decisions, metadata, structured data and Core Web Vitals, each demanding evidence rather than a summary
Conversion & Revenue Optimization Toolkit Thirteen modules, 70 workflows, 68 commands, six report templates and four worked examples — the master CRO audit, funnels, analytics verification, experimentation, and the prohibitions on manipulative tactics

And after launch

The three systems here take a site to live, found and converting. Keeping it that way — monitoring, security checks, tested backups, dependency updates, a gate on both sides of every deploy, incident playbooks and a monthly report — is the Website Operations & Maintenance System, a fourth product sold on its own and not included in this bundle.

What using all three looks like

A concrete sequence, in the order the products are meant to be used:

  1. Build. The master build prompt establishes the repository, the CLAUDE.md and the checks. You finish with a site that has never been deployed without its own tests running.
  2. Launch. The launch checklists cover the things that are cheap before launch and expensive after: canonicals, robots, redirects, analytics that actually fires, a 404 that works.
  3. Audit. The SEO toolkit runs in dependency order. Crawlability first, because optimising a title on a URL about to be canonicalised away is wasted work.
  4. Rank. Search Console work on the pages that already have impressions, rather than publishing more pages nobody has found yet.
  5. Convert. The master CRO audit produces findings with evidence and an honesty label — proven bug, strong heuristic, experiment opportunity, or insufficient data — ranked by impact and confidence over effort.
  6. Validate. The experimentation system decides whether you have the traffic to test at all, and says so plainly when you do not.

Who this is for

People who own a website end to end and expect to keep owning it: developers, technical founders, and agencies running the same lifecycle across several sites. It assumes you can read a diff, run a command, and reach your own live site.

Who this is not for

If you only have one of the three problems, buy the one product. The bundle is cheaper than three but more expensive than one, and there is no advantage to owning a system you are not going to open.

It is also not for anyone wanting conversion tactics that manipulate. The conversion toolkit prohibits fake countdowns, fake scarcity, fabricated customer numbers, confirmshaming and the rest by name, and refuses to generate them.

And it is not a service. Nobody audits your site for you; these are systems you run.

Delivery and licence

Three downloads, available immediately after purchase, as ZIP archives of plain Markdown. Every file is readable in any text editor, with or without Claude Code.

The licence is per person, for unlimited projects — including client work. Buying the bundle does not change that: it is still one person, now with three products. It is not a team or company licence, and the files are not to be redistributed.

A refund is given where the download link did not work, the file was corrupt or incomplete, you were charged twice or in error, or the product is materially different from how this page describes it. If you have looked at it and decided it is not for you, email admin@sitebuilderstack.com and say why. The full terms, and your statutory rights — which nothing on this page limits — are in the refund policy.

launch-system.title: The Claude Code Website Launch System
launch-system.descriptionHtml:
Build production-ready websites with Claude Code.

Claude Code will build almost anything you ask it to. That is the problem. Ask it to “build me a website” and you get a website — a different one each time, with a different structure, no SEO architecture, no security review, and no plan for what happens after it is deployed.

The Claude Code Website Launch System is the repeatable process that fixes that: a complete set of prompts, configuration templates, workflows, audits, and checklists for directing Claude Code through research, planning, architecture, build, content, SEO, security, accessibility, testing, deployment, indexing, and the first thirty days after launch.

What you receive

A single ZIP file containing 113 files across 17 modules — over 700 KB of Markdown, more than 110,000 words. Everything is plain Markdown you own outright. Nothing to install, no subscription, nothing that phones home. You run the workflows yourself inside Claude Code, so you need Claude Code and a terminal; the files themselves need nothing but a text editor.

  • 01 — Master System. The flagship end-to-end website builder prompt, staged across fifteen gated phases, plus the discovery, planning, and roadmap chain.
  • 02 — Claude Code Configuration. A production-grade CLAUDE.md template, and a guide to how memory files actually load, what belongs in them, and why shorter files are followed more reliably.
  • 03 — SEO System. Search architecture, technical audit, keyword research, intent classification, the content cluster system, internal linking, schema, sitemaps, robots.txt, and llms.txt.
  • 04–08 — Platform Systems. Shopify, WordPress, Astro, SaaS applications, and landing pages — each with its own build prompt, audits, and launch checklist.
  • 09–10 — Deployment. GitHub repository setup, the full CI/CD workflow, four working GitHub Actions files, and Cloudflare DNS, Pages, caching, and security guides.
  • 11 — Security. Secret scanning, OWASP review, dependency auditing, HTTP security headers, and a production security checklist.
  • 12 — Accessibility. WCAG 2.2 AA audit, keyboard navigation, screen reader testing, and a working checklist.
  • 13 — Search Engines. Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, and IndexNow workflows, with honest expectations about what submission does and does not do.
  • 14 — Checklists. Pre-launch, launch day, first 24 hours, 7-day, and 30-day reviews.
  • 15 — Prompt Library. 100 reusable single-purpose prompts across eleven categories, ready to save as slash commands.
  • 16–17 — Templates & Bonus. Project briefs, technical specs, QA and launch reports, plus website rescue, existing-site audit, redesign, competitor analysis, and AI code review prompts.

How it is delivered

This is a digital product. Nothing is shipped. After checkout you receive a download link for claude-code-website-launch-system-v1.0.zip. Unzip it and open START-HERE.md.

What you need

Claude Code, installed and logged in. Per Anthropic’s documentation that requires a Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise, or Console account — the free Claude.ai plan does not include Claude Code. Git and a terminal you are comfortable in. Nothing else.

You do not need to be a professional developer. You do need to be willing to read what Claude produces and push back when it is wrong; the system is built around that habit.

Licence

One person, unlimited projects, including paid client work. You may modify anything and keep everything you produce with it. You may not redistribute, resell, or repackage the files themselves. Full terms are included in the download.

What this is not

It is not an ebook, an app, a plugin, or a subscription. It does not generate websites by itself, and it makes no promise about rankings, traffic, or revenue — it is a professional system for directing Claude Code through the work, and the work still has to be reviewed by you.

Site Builder Stack is an independent product and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Anthropic. “Claude” and “Claude Code” are product names and trademarks of Anthropic, PBC.
